productArea.name: Vouchers
productArea.scope: Search, filter, sort, create, and edit vouchers, including codes, the setup checklist, discount types, eligibility, countries, requirements, channels, scheduling, and save or discard behavior. Promotions and editing linked products or channels are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Discounts then Vouchers, and open a voucher for its codes, eligibility, requirements, channels, and schedule.
Choose Create voucher from the list.
